responsibility: This module holds the target-independent documentation sources that define the user-visible GNU Modula-2 language and library surface independent of any particular machine backend. Its files describe the GM2 grammar accepted by the front end, the published intrinsic and builtin procedures treated specially by the compiler, and the standard low-level `SYSTEM` interfaces for both ISO and PIM dialects, including address, size, bit-manipulation, and exception-related operations that bridge language semantics to runtime support. It also provides the top-level reference structure for GM2 libraries and bundled legal/manual support text. As a localization unit, this module represents the language-definition and library-interface specification side of GM2 rather than target-specific code generation or runtime implementation.
